WITH cust_spend AS (
    SELECT
        t."CustomerID",
        SUM(t."Amount" * t."Price") AS total_spent
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
    WHERE t."Date" BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31'
    GROUP BY t."CustomerID"
)
SELECT
    csp."CustomerID",
    CASE
        WHEN csp.total_spent >= 10000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN csp.total_spent >= 5000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS loyalty_tier
FROM cust_spend csp
ORDER BY csp."CustomerID";

WHERE strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2012'

WITH cust_spent AS (
    SELECT t.CustomerID,
           SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_spent
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2012'
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID
),
tiered AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS tile
    FROM cust_spent
)
SELECT CustomerID,
       CASE tile
           WHEN 1 THEN 'gold'
           WHEN 2 THEN 'silver'
           WHEN 3 THEN 'bronze'
       END AS loyalty_tier
FROM tiered
ORDER BY CustomerID;

JOIN "customers" c ON t."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID"
LEFT JOIN "exchange_rates" r ON r."Date" = t."Date"

GROUP BY t."CustomerID";

WITH monthly_spend AS (
    SELECT
        t.CustomerID,
        strftime('%Y%m', t.Date) AS ym,
        SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS eur_total
    FROM transactions_1k t
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID, ym
),
monthly_rate AS (
    SELECT
        Date AS ym,
        AVG(Consumption) AS rate
    FROM yearmonth
    GROUP BY Date
)
SELECT
    AVG(ms.eur_total) AS avg_eur,
    AVG(ms.eur_total * mr.rate) AS avg_usd
FROM monthly_spend ms
JOIN monthly_rate mr ON ms.ym = mr.ym
JOIN customers c ON ms.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(y.Consumption), 2) AS avg_eur, ROUND(AVG(y.Consumption) * 1.1, 2) AS avg_usd FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID GROUP BY c.Segment

WITH monthly_rates AS (
    SELECT substr(Date, 1, 4) AS year,
           substr(Date, 5, 2) AS month,
           Currency,
           AVG(Rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM exchange_rates
    WHERE year = '2012'
    GROUP BY year, month, Currency
)
SELECT c.Segment,
       SUM(t.Amount * t.Price * COALESCE(r.avg_rate, 1)) AS total_revenue_eur
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN monthly_rates r ON r.year = substr(t.Date, 1, 4)
                         AND r.month = substr(t.Date, 6, 2)
                         AND r.Currency = c.Currency
WHERE substr(t.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
GROUP BY c.Segment;

    c.Segment,
    SUM(t.Price) AS total_revenue
FROM transactions_1k t
INNER JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

GROUP BY c.Segment

GROUP BY t.CustomerID

WITH monthly_emissions AS (
    SELECT t.CustomerID,
           strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) AS month,
           SUM(t.Amount * CASE
               WHEN p.Description LIKE '%Nafta%'   THEN 2.68
               WHEN p.Description LIKE '%Super%'   THEN 2.31
               WHEN p.Description LIKE '%Natural%' THEN 2.0
               WHEN p.Description LIKE '%Special%' THEN 2.5
               ELSE 0
           END) AS emissions
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
    JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID, month
),
avg_emissions AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           AVG(emissions) AS avg_monthly_emissions
    FROM monthly_emissions
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
max_avg AS (
    SELECT MAX(avg_monthly_emissions) AS max_avg
    FROM avg_emissions
)
SELECT CustomerID
FROM avg_emissions
WHERE avg_monthly_emissions = (SELECT max_avg FROM max_avg);

WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT t.CustomerID,
           strftime('%Y%m', t.Date) AS month,
           SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS expenditure
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'USD'
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID, month
), avg_expenditure AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           AVG(expenditure) AS avg_monthly_expenditure
    FROM monthly
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING AVG(expenditure) > 150
), max_month AS (
    SELECT m.CustomerID,
           m.month,
           m.expenditure AS amount_usd
    FROM monthly m
    JOIN avg_expenditure a ON m.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
    WHERE m.expenditure = (
        SELECT MAX(expenditure)
        FROM monthly
        WHERE CustomerID = m.CustomerID
    )
)
SELECT CustomerID, month, amount_usd
FROM max_month
ORDER BY CustomerID;

WITH customer_avg AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING AVG(Consumption) > 150
),
ranked_monthly AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, y.Date, y.Consumption,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY y.CustomerID ORDER BY y.Consumption DESC) AS rn
    FROM yearmonth y
    INNER JOIN customer_avg ca ON y.CustomerID = ca.CustomerID
)
SELECT CustomerID, Date, Consumption
FROM ranked_monthly
WHERE rn = 1

with monthly_exp as (
    select
        t.CustomerID,
        strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) as ym,
        sum(t.Amount * t.Price) as exp
    from "transactions_1k" t
    group by t.CustomerID, ym
),
avg_exp as (
    select
        CustomerID,
        avg(exp) as avg_exp
    from monthly_exp
    group by CustomerID
    having avg_exp > 150
),
ranked as (
    select
        me.CustomerID,
        me.ym,
        me.exp,
        rank() over (partition by me.CustomerID order by me.exp desc) as rnk
    from monthly_exp me
    join avg_exp ae on me.CustomerID = ae.CustomerID
)
select
    CustomerID,
    replace(ym, '-', '') as Month,
    exp as AmountUSD
from ranked
where rnk = 1;

WHERE s.total_spent > (SELECT avg_spent FROM threshold);

SELECT t.CustomerID,
       AVG(t.monthly_amount) AS avg_liters
FROM (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS yr_month,
           SUM(Amount) AS monthly_amount
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID, yr_month
) AS t
GROUP BY t.CustomerID
ORDER BY t.CustomerID;
SELECT CustomerID, AVG(Consumption) AS avg_liters_per_month FROM yearmonth GROUP BY CustomerID
SELECT "CustomerID", AVG("Consumption") AS avg_liters_per_month FROM "yearmonth" GROUP BY "CustomerID";

votes.sql:
SELECT t.CustomerID,
       SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_spent_usd
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE strftime('%Y', t.Date) = strftime('%Y','now')
GROUP BY t.CustomerID
HAVING SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) > 5000;

WITH max_year AS (
    SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', MAX(Date)) AS TEXT) AS yr
    FROM transactions_1k
)
SELECT 
    t.CustomerID,
    ROUND(SUM(t.Price) * 1.1, 2) AS spending_usd
FROM transactions_1k t
INNER JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
CROSS JOIN max_year my
WHERE strftime('%Y', t.Date) = my.yr
GROUP BY t.CustomerID
HAVING SUM(t.Price) * 1.1 > 5000

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT t.CustomerID, SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_spent
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t.Date) = (SELECT strftime('%Y', MAX(Date)) FROM transactions_1k)
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID
)
SELECT CustomerID, total_spent AS total_spent_usd
FROM yearly
WHERE total_spent > 5000;

SELECT t.CustomerID,
       CASE 
         WHEN SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) >= 10000 THEN 'Platinum'
         WHEN SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) >= 5000 THEN 'Gold'
         ELSE 'Silver'
       END AS vip_tier
FROM "transactions_1k" t
GROUP BY t.CustomerID

SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) >= 10000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) >= 5000 THEN 'Gold'
        ELSE 'Silver'
    END AS VIP_Tier
FROM customers c
INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) >= 10000 THEN 1
        WHEN SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) >= 5000 THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END,
    SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) DESC

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        t."CustomerID",
        SUM(t."Amount" * t."Price") AS total_spent
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
    GROUP BY t."CustomerID"
)
SELECT
    cs."CustomerID",
    CASE
        WHEN cs.total_spent >= 10000 THEN 'platinum'
        WHEN cs.total_spent >= 5000 THEN 'gold'
        WHEN cs.total_spent >= 1000 THEN 'silver'
    END AS vip_tier
FROM customer_spend cs
WHERE cs.total_spent >= 1000;

WITH monthly_emissions AS (
    SELECT
        t.CustomerID,
        strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) AS month,
        SUM(t.Amount * CASE p.Description
            WHEN 'Nafta'   THEN 2.68
            WHEN 'Super'   THEN 2.31
            WHEN 'Natural' THEN 2.00
            ELSE 0
        END) AS month_emission
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
    JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
    WHERE t.Date >= '2012-01-01' AND t.Date < '2013-01-01'
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID, month
)
SELECT
    CustomerID,
    month,
    SUM(month_emission) OVER (
        PARTITION BY CustomerID
        ORDER BY month
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_total_emissions
FROM monthly_emissions
ORDER BY running_total_emissions DESC;

filtered AS (
    SELECT t.CustomerID,
           strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) AS month,

    FROM "transactions_1k" t

votes.sql:
SELECT 
    t.CustomerID,
    strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) AS month,
    SUM(t.Amount * t.Price * COALESCE(r.RateToEUR, 1)) AS total_eur
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN exchange_rates AS r ON r.Date = t.Date AND r.Currency = c.Currency
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, month
ORDER BY t.CustomerID, month;

SELECT 
    t.CustomerID,
    strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) AS month,
    SUM(t.Price) AS total_spent_euros
FROM transactions_1k t
INNER JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date)
ORDER BY t.CustomerID, strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date)

SELECT SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_eur
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date);

votes.sql:
WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        t.CustomerID,
        strftime('%Y', t.Date) AS year,
        SUM(t.Amount) AS total_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.Description = 'Natural' THEN t.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS bio_amount
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
    JOIN "products" p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID, strftime('%Y', t.Date)
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM yearly
    WHERE total_amount > 0
      AND (bio_amount * 1.0) / total_amount >= 0.6
)
SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID
FROM qualified;

votes.sql:
WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Date, Consumption,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM yearmonth
),
latest AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Consumption AS latest_consumption
    FROM ordered
    WHERE rn = 1
),
previous AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Consumption AS prev_consumption
    FROM ordered
    WHERE rn = 2
)
SELECT l.CustomerID
FROM latest l
JOIN previous p USING (CustomerID)
WHERE l.latest_consumption > p.prev_consumption;

WITH period AS (
        SELECT *
        FROM "transactions_1k"
        WHERE "Date" >= (SELECT date(max("Date"), '-6 months') FROM "transactions_1k")
    ),
    customer_totals AS (
        SELECT "CustomerID",
               SUM("Amount") AS total_volume
        FROM period
        GROUP BY "CustomerID"
    ),
    total AS (
        SELECT SUM(total_volume) AS overall_volume FROM customer_totals
    ),
    ranked AS (
        SELECT ct."CustomerID",
               ct.total_volume,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ct.total_volume DESC) AS rk,
               (ct.total_volume * 100.0) / t.overall_volume AS pct
        FROM customer_totals ct, total t
    )
SELECT "CustomerID",
       rk AS rank,
       ROUND(pct, 2) AS percentage
FROM ranked
WHERE rk <= 3
ORDER BY rk;

)

FROM customer_emissions
